title: On the convex structure of the space of quantum channels which act as Fourier multipliers
summary: If $G$ is a compact group, continuous normalized positive definite functions are in one-to-one correspondence with unital quantum channels acting as Fourier multipliers on the group von Neumann algebra $\mathrm{VN}(G)$. We study the convex geometry of the convex set $\mathrm{P}_1(G)$ of normalized positive definite functions, equipped with the topology induced by the norm topology of the Fourier algebra $\mathrm{A}(G)$, and its relation with the structure of $\mathrm{VN}(G)$.
